description.text: 这是一首面向低龄儿童的英语儿歌，主题为日常动作与活动，体裁为 Dance Pop，英语难度为 Pre A1。歌词通过重复句式和高能量节拍，引导孩子跟做 walking、running、standing、sitting、drawing、reading 等基础动作，营造欢乐的互动氛围。虽然难度极低，但歌曲节奏明快、动作性强，更适合幼儿启蒙。适合学龄前/幼儿、约 3-6 岁的学习者，用于跟唱、动作模仿和基础动词输入。

An English children's song focused on daily actions and activities in a Dance Pop style at Pre A1 level. The repetitive lyrics and high-energy beat encourage kids to move along with basic actions like walking, running, standing, sitting, drawing, and reading, creating a lively interactive experience. Extremely simple language and strong action cues make it ideal for early childhood learners: best suited for preschool/kindergarten children, approximately ages 3-6, for sing-along, movement imitation, and basic verb exposure.

description.text: 这是一首面向幼儿的英语儿歌，主题为友谊与连接，体裁为古风故事歌谣（GuFeng Story Ballad），英语难度约 Pre A1。歌词通过男孩在公园独自走路、女孩在石头上画画，随后一群孩子跑步、阅读、并肩而坐等画面，反复吟唱“他们是朋友，一起玩耍永不结束”，传递友谊和分享的快乐。句式简单、重复性强、旋律感明显，适合学龄前或幼儿启蒙阶段、约 3-6 岁的学习者，用于跟唱、语感培养和基础词汇积累。

An English children's song on the theme of friendship and connection, in a GuFeng Story Ballad style at roughly Pre A1 level. The lyrics depict a boy walking alone, a girl drawing on a stone, then children running, reading, and sitting together, with a repetitive chorus emphasizing friendship and never-ending play. With simple, repetitive sentences and a clear melodic structure, it suits preschool and early childhood learners (ages ~3-6) for sing-along, building language intuition, and learning basic vocabulary.

description.text: 这是一个面向英语入门学习者的对话式轻故事，适合以动画或绘本形式呈现。内容围绕两个女孩通电话，相互询问和描述正在做的事情，自然引入现在进行时（I am drawing/reading/standing/running 等）和基础动作词汇。故事简单、重复性高，场景贴近日常生活，难度为 Pre A1，非常适合帮助初学者掌握现在进行时句型和常见活动表达。

A simple dialogue-based English story for absolute beginners, best understood as animation or picture-book content. It follows two girls chatting on the phone, asking and describing what they are doing, naturally introducing the present continuous tense (I am drawing/reading/standing/running, etc.) and basic action verbs. The story is repetitive and set in relatable everyday scenarios, at a Pre A1 level, ideal for learners to grasp present continuous patterns and common activity expressions.

description.text: 这是一条面向初学者的英语对话式故事内容，场景设定在安静的图书馆里。故事围绕 Lily 和 Kai 因为一本动物书相识的过程展开，通过观察图书馆里其他孩子的行为，大量复现 sitting、reading、running、standing、drawing 等现在进行时动作，以及 in the library、on a cushion、at the table 等位置表达。整体难度为 Pre A1，句式简短、重复，可理解为动画或绘本式叙事，适合培养基础听读能力和交际启蒙。

This is a beginner-friendly English dialogue story set in a quiet library. It follows Lily and Kai as they become friends over an animal book, and by observing other children, it repeatedly uses present continuous actions like sitting, reading, running, standing, drawing, and location phrases such as in the library, on a cushion, at the table. The level is Pre A1, with short, repetitive sentences, and can be understood as animation or picture-book style content, suitable for building basic listening, reading and communication skills.
